newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Earthgrains raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Earthgrains raised to buy.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities analyst David Nelson said Monday he raised his rating on Earthgrains Co, which makes fresh baked goods and refrigerated dough, to a buy from accumulate.
-- He also raised his earnings estimate for Earthgrains for fiscal 1997 to $1.60 a share from $0.70.

-- This followed stronger than expected second quarter earnings reported by Earthgrains of $0.51 a share, before charges, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.32, also before a charge. Nelson said he had expected earnings of $0.12 a share for the quarter.
-- "There is a tremendous amount of earnings leverage at Earthgrains," Nelson said.
-- He said the baking industry, which is consolidating, has seen improved pricing. He added that Earthgrains, itself, is reaping the benefits from previous restructuring actions.
-- In its earnings statement, Earthgrains said it has the potential for additional improvements, "and will continue to participate in industry consolidation and brand building."
-- Nelson added that wheat input costs for Earthgrains have peaked at least in the near term.
